LESSON MENU
Rectangles can come in a wide variety of shapes. A rectangle can be long and skinny or short and fat, as long as each angle is 90 degrees.
A square has four sides with each angle containing 90 degrees. The square is special because the lengths of all the sides are the same.

Keep in mind that differently shaped rectangles can have the exact same area. For example, these two rectangles, although quite different in appearance, have the same areas. A = 8 cm x 2 cm 2. A = 16 cm 2. A = 16 cm 2. A = 16 cm
